gyri-oros-machaira.description_en: Oros Machaira pollen is collected from our own hives, is placed on the market fresh and is not processed at all. A gift from our bees to you.

vasilikos-poltos-oros-machaira.description_en: Like pollen and honey, royal jelly is a real natural treasure made by bees, with the difference being that it is made exclusively to feed the queen! It is the par excellence food for royalty, used to give the queen enough energy to grow rapidly and to produce thousands of eggs every day. Royal jelly has been used since antiquity because it provides energy, stimulates the libido and is a key factor in longevity. It is exceptionally effective in combating numerous external threats to human health and well-being. Our royal jelly is produced by our bee-keepers and is placed on the market fresh.

kirithra-oros-machaira.description_en: Oros Machaira honeycomb is yet another gift from bees to us. By eating honeycomb you’re eating honey in the way bees prefer it. At the same time, you’re getting all the nutritional properties not just of honey but also of beeswax. Honeycomb is an ideal choice when you crave something sweet. By eating honeycomb, you satisfy your need for something sweet while at the same time offering your body a treasure trove of nutrients. Oros Machaira Honeycomb comes from the same bees Oros Machaira honey comes from and is cut and marketed in convenient packaging to allow you to enjoy it with ease.

vamma-propolis-oros-machaira.description_en: Propolis tincture is an alcohol solution made of alcohol and propolis and is nothing short of a natural antiseptic miracle. Taking propolis tincture daily in small doses can help bolster the immune system in its fight against bacteria, fungi and viruses, including the flu. In contrast to medicines that affect both beneficial and harmful bacteria, propolis tincture only affects bacteria that are harmful to our health and in general is not impacted by various bacterial mutations. Oros Machaira Propolis Tincture is prepared at our lab using alcohol and propolis taken straight from our bee-keepers’ honeybees.

meli-antheon-oros-machaira.description_en: Cyprus’ rich flora allows us to produce a rich and unique blossom honey. Blossom honey primarily consists of nectar from orange blossom, wild lavender, myrtle, germander, and other wild plants from Cyprus.

avrasto-meli-antheon-oros-machaira.description_en: Honey is considered to be “unheated” when it comes straight from the honeycomb without any processing and is sold to consumers just as the bees make it. Unlike honey which undergoes heat treatment and filtering, raw honey retains all its yeasts and pollen grains, which are what give it its high nutritional value.

thymarisio-meli-oros-machaira.description_en: Strongly aromatic, Oros Machaira thyme honey is packed with flavour. It is considered to be Cyprus’ best and most expensive honey.

melissokeri.description_en: Pure beeswax is one of the many bee products. The bees use it to store their honey in. Beeswax can be used by people in a variety of home-made cosmetics. You can make hand creams, lotions, lip balm, hair products and many other natural, cost-effective cosmetics. It has soothing and emollient properties and when used on the skin it keeps it moisturised. Beeswax has been used as an antiseptic, and studies show that in the past it was used to treat wounds. You get the chance to buy pure, organic beeswax and get it delivered anywhere in Cyprus. Delivery is carried out through ACS or Akis Express.
